text: Assist patients in organizing their health care system activities.
Direct workers on cutting teams.
Describe and recommend wines to customers.
Plan, supervise, and review work of assigned subordinates.
Operate and maintain laser plate-making equipment that converts electronic data to plates without the use of film.
Clean, maintain, calibrate, or repair measuring instruments or test equipment, such as dial indicators, fixed gauges, or height gauges.
Modify, update, or process existing policies and claims to reflect any change in beneficiary, amount of coverage, or type of insurance.
Collaborate with other departments to integrate logistics with business systems or processes, such as customer sales, order management, accounting, or shipping.
Inform job applicants of details such as duties and responsibilities, compensation, benefits, schedules, working conditions, or promotion opportunities.

Prepare and maintain records and case files, including documentation, such as clients' personal and eligibility information, services provided, narratives of client contacts, or relevant correspondence.
Advise management on whether continued operation of equipment could be hazardous.
Participate in product design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, or potential problems.

Operate or tend stationary engines, boilers, and auxiliary equipment, such as pumps, compressors, or air-conditioning equipment, to supply and maintain steam or heat for buildings, marine vessels, or pneumatic tools.
Assess companies as investments for clients by examining company facilities.
Write or revise standard operating procedures for logistics processes.
Demonstrate system functionality and performance, including start-up, shut-down, normal operation, and emergency or bypass operations.
Identify and recommend environmentally friendly business practices.
Negotiate details of contracts and payments.
Develop or test new drugs or medications intended for commercial distribution.
Advertise products and work, using media such as internet advertising and brochures.
Direct the preparation of regular and special budget reports.
Chair nursing departments or committees.
Develop or modify industrial electronic devices, circuits, or equipment, according to available specifications.
Obtain plans from display designers or display managers and discuss their implementation with clients or supervisors.
Inspect, maintain, and replace batteries as needed.
Evaluate modes of training delivery, such as in-person or virtual, to optimize training effectiveness, training costs, or environmental impacts.
Take thorough and accurate patient medical histories.
Tear down, repair, and rebuild faulty assemblies, such as power systems, steering systems, and linkages.
Supervise students' laboratory and field work.
Develop data models and databases.
Review operational expenses, budget estimates, betting accounts, or collection reports for accuracy.
Advise surgeon of a patient's risk status and recommend appropriate intervention to minimize risk.
Produce and distribute project documents.
Record operating data, such as the results of surveillance tests.
Start machines, monitor their operations, and record operational data.
Solicit project support by conferring with officials or providing information to the public.
Seek new ways to improve efficiency and increase profits.
Prepare and process import and export documentation according to customs regulations, laws, or procedures.
Ensure timely and efficient movement of trains, according to train orders and schedules.
Translate electromechanical drawings into design specifications, applying principles of engineering, thermal or fluid sciences, mathematics, or statistics.
Identify, evaluate, or procure hardware or software for implementing online marketing campaigns.
Design, implement, or maintain fraud detection tools or procedures.
Prepare and balance period-end reports, and reconcile issued payrolls to bank statements.
Recommend methods to protect the environment or minimize environmental damage from industrial production practices.
Manipulate controls, levers, and valves to start pumps, auxiliary equipment, or conveyors, and to adjust equipment positions, speeds, timing, and material flows.
Inform customers about foreign currency regulations and compute transaction fees for currency exchanges.
Perform maintenance tasks necessary to keep equipment working properly.
Demonstrate use of solar and related equipment to customers or dealers.
